question: Which of the following Himalayan peaks is **NOT **located in Nepal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamet**__.

__
 
• **Kamet is the **____**Himalayan peak that is NOT located in Nepal**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• **Kamet **is the second-highest mountain in the Garhwal region of Uttarakhand, India after Nanda Devi.

 
 
• It lies in the Chamoli district of **Uttarakhand**.
 
• **Glaciers**: The West Kamet Glacier, The East Kamet Glacier, and the Raikana Glacier system surrounds Kamet.
 
• **Rivers**: The west Kamet glacier drains into the Saraswati River and the east Kamet glacier feeds the Dhauliganga River.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Makalu** is located in the Mahalangur Himalayas southeast of Mount Everest on the border between **Nepal **and Tibet Autonomous Region.

 
 
• It is the fifth highest mountain in the world at 8485 m (approx).
 
 
 
• **Mount Everest** the Earth's highest mountain above sea level is located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas.
 
 
• The China-Nepal border runs across its summit point.
 
 
 
• **Annapurna** is a mountain situated in the Annapurna mountain range of Gandaki Province, north-central **Nepal**.
 
 
• It is the tenth-highest mountain in the world at 8091 m(approx) above sea level.
